# Design system

BNP ref: `DESIGN.md`, `src/app/globals.css` (`@theme`), `src/app/themes.css`, `src/components/ui/CardKit.tsx`.

## Feeling

Calm, flat, content first, chrome quiet. One accent colour (the user's) meaning "your next step" or "tap this", at most
three per screen. Everything else is the neutral ramp, tinted very slightly toward the accent's hue so the app feels like
one material. States (success, warning, danger) are their own hues, always paired with a word.

## Colour contract (generated by `scripts/palette.mjs`)

| Token | Meaning | Tailwind use |
|---|---|---|
| `--c-s-50` ... `--c-s-950` | ramp: LOW = strongest text, HIGH = page ground, in BOTH themes | `text-slate-50` (text), `text-slate-400` (secondary), `text-slate-500` (labels, the faintest text), `border-slate-800` (hairline), `bg-slate-950` (page) |
| `--c-ground` / `--c-card` / `--c-lift` | page, card, card-in-card or hover | `bg-ground`, `bg-card`, `bg-lift` |
| `--signal` | the accent fill | `bg-signal`, `border-signal`, `ring-signal` |
| `--signal-fg` | the accent AS TEXT (moved until 4.5:1) | `text-signal-fg`, never `text-signal` |
| `--signal-ink` | the label ON an accent fill | `text-signal-ink` |
| `--c-a-100..500` | accent tints and shades | progress, selected chips, a darker fill if the label check fails |
| `--c-em-*` / `--c-ye-*` / `--c-rd-*` | success / warning / danger (300, 400 text; 500 fill with a white label) | `text-emerald-400`, `text-yellow-300`, `text-red-400`, `bg-red-500` |

Map Tailwind's colour names onto the contract in `@theme inline`, so `slate`, `emerald`, `yellow`, `red` and the custom
names all resolve to the theme: `--color-slate-50: rgb(var(--c-s-50));` and so on. Channels are space-separated so
`bg-signal/16` works. Theme switch: `data-theme="light|dark"` on `<html>`, set before paint from a cookie or
localStorage with a tiny inline script, following `prefers-color-scheme` until the person picks.

Rules: no hex in components. `white`/`black` remapped to the theme's own near-white and near-black. Photos, logos and
illustrations keep their own colours. A control with its own solid fill is never covered by a glass effect.

## Type

Two families: a display face for page titles only (BNP: Baloo 2; pick one that suits the brand, rounded for friendly,
a serif for premium, a grotesk for tools) and one body face for everything else (BNP: Nunito), self-hosted as a variable
woff2 via `next/font/local`. Tabular numbers in the signed-in app.

| Token | Size / line | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `text-caption` | 12 / 1.35 | labels under values, meta, counts |
| `text-small` | 13 / 1.4 | buttons, rows, most UI text |
| `text-body` | 16 / 1.6 | reading text; EVERY input, select and textarea (iOS zoom) |
| `text-title` | 20 / 1.3 | a card's heading |
| `text-headline` | 24 / 1.2 | the one big line on a feature card |
| `text-hero` | clamp(28px, 5vw, 44px) / 1.02 | the page title, one per page |
| `text-figure` | clamp(52px, 9vw, 64px) / 1 | a counter that is the point of the screen |

Weights: 400 text, 500 labels, 600 titles and buttons. Headings `text-wrap: balance`, paragraphs `pretty`.

## Shape and depth

8 small chips · 12 fields, rows and control boxes · 16 cards · 24 sheets · full pills for buttons, chips, avatars, the
dock. Squircle corners (`corner-shape: squircle`) where supported, never on circles. Cards are a solid fill with no border.
Buttons are raised a little, lift on hover, press to 0.97. Only floating things (menus, dialogs, sheets, dock, top bar) get
the floating shadow.

## Hierarchy (the ten rules)

1. One focal point per card: the name or the one figure that matters, `text-title` in `text-slate-50`.
2. Three sizes and three tones per card, never more.
3. Emphasize by de-emphasizing. A label sits UNDER its value (`Fact`), in `text-caption text-slate-500`.
4. Group by proximity; a hairline separates head, facts and actions.
5. Status only when it is news: one `StatusDot` with a word, top right. Healthy states get no badge.
6. One filled accent button per card. One or two quiet buttons. Everything else, and anything destructive, in a More
   menu (`ActionMenu`), destructive last, red, behind a confirm.
7. Links look like links only inside sentences; elsewhere a row with a chevron, or the whole card is the link.
8. Similar things are rows with hairlines, not a pile of equal cards.
9. Show three to five, fold the rest ("Show N more").
10. One hero per screen: one band carrying the screen's ONE fact, a sheet over its edge with that fact's controls, two to
    four action tiles for what people do next.

Kit (`CardKit.tsx`): `CardHead`, `Facts` + `Fact`, `Meta`, `Callout` (the one problem), `CardFoot`. Use them everywhere.

## Shell

- **Top bar**: logo, the one live badge (credits, balance, next session), assistant button, avatar. On phones every other
  button moves into the avatar menu (CSS `hidden md:contents`, so it follows resizing).
- **Sidebar** from md up; collapsible with `B`.
- **Dock**: floating pill near the bottom, always visible on every device, five slots, a sliding capsule behind the
  current tab, a red unread dot, shrinks while scrolling down. The scroll area keeps `pb-32` at every width.
- **Command menu** (Cmd/Ctrl-K or `/`), `?` for the shortcut sheet, `G` then a letter to jump. Shortcuts never animate.
- **Back** is always `BackLink` (`router.back()` with an `href` fallback), never a hard-coded `Link`.
- **Banners**: at most one at a time, only on Home, at most once per time slot; whatever a banner asks also lands in the bell.

## Motion

150 to 200 ms hover and press, 240 ms entering, iOS ease. Page arrival: 200 ms fade and 6 px rise, no overshoot. Springs
only for the dock and drag release. Animate `transform` and `opacity` only. `prefers-reduced-motion` gets none.

## Accessibility (a gate, not a polish pass)

- 16px minimum on inputs; 44px touch targets on touch devices (a `tap` utility); icon targets at least 24px.
- Dialogs: focus in, Tab trapped, Escape closes, focus returns (`useDialogFocus`). Phone dialogs are bottom sheets.
- Text 4.5:1 in both themes (the palette script guarantees the tokens; you must use the right token).
- Links inside running text are underlined. No `aria-label` on a bare `span`/`p`.
- Run axe-core (WCAG 2.2 AA) on every main screen in both themes before calling a phase done.
- Check every screen at 1440, 768, 390 and 320 px; no horizontal scroll, nothing under the dock.

## Copy

Plain, short, sentence case, second person. No em dashes. No invented numbers, quotes or ratings. No "i" icon carrying a
screen's own message: if the words matter, show them. A consequence that costs money or cannot be undone is a short plain
line beside the action. Empty states say what to do next.
